BranchPicker.note: Stateful picker composed the way it ships: PopoverSearchField row with the muted magnifier and borderless input, then PopoverMenuItem rows with a Check on the selected branch, all inside the popover surface.

FilteredSearch.note: Live search value narrowing the list to one match — shows the filtered state rather than only the resting one.

EmptyResults.note: emptyLabel branch renders (children passed as null), giving the muted 'No environments match' row under the search field. Exactly the documented fallback.

WithoutSearch.note: onSearchChange omitted so the search row is suppressed and the body renders alone — the other half of the component's conditional.
